articles.summary: HARTFORD, Conn. & BOSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 6, 2026-- Eversource Energy (NYSE: ES) today reported GAAP earnings of $606.8 million, or $1.61 per share, for the first quarter of 2026, compared with GAAP and non-GAAP earnings of $550.8 million, or $1.50 per share, for the first quarter of 2025.
articles.title: Eversource Energy Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
